english.note: Use this all-purpose noun when referring to the letters or text of a document, especially its readability or size.
Use this everyday word for a written or printed character, especially a Chinese character or letter.

examples.english: The print on the paper is too small for me to read.
examples.traditional: 張紙啲字太細，我睇唔清。
